remarks: Highest and Best by Saturday June 29 at 12PM. This recently updated 3- bedroom, 2- bathroom gem sits on beautifully manicured grounds located in Spring Hill neighborhood, offering a perfect blend of modern convenience and serene living. From the moment you step inside, you will be captivated by the thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship, and attention to detail that make this house a true standout. The open-concept living area with the adjoining dining area is ideal for hosting family dinners, relaxation and entertaining. The heart of this home is undoubtedly the stunning gourmet kitchen, equipped with top of the line stainless steel appliances, elegant cabinetry, and sleek quartz countertops. 3 good size bedrooms are designed with comfort in mind to relax and unwind. Both bathroom in this home have been meticulously updated with modern finishes and fixtures. Step outside in the backyard to discover your own private oasis. This home additional features lower level family room to enhance your living experience, laundry room, a new central air conditioning, and an attached garage and ample storage closet space. New Andersen windows with lifetime warranty. Enjoy gorgeous sunsets and beautiful evenings on the deck or a beautiful patio. Detached storage shed. You will be just minutes away from local schools, parks, shopping centers and dining options. Close to I-95 or Merritt Parkway. Must See!!
